products.name: Cashmere Blend Wrap Dress
products.description: An elegant wrap dress crafted from a soft cashmere blend. Features a flattering V-neckline and adjustable waist tie for a custom fit. Perfect for office to evening transitions.

products.name: Linen Wide-Leg Trousers
products.description: Effortlessly chic wide-leg trousers in breathable linen. High-waisted silhouette with front pleats and side pockets. A wardrobe essential for warm-weather styling.

products.name: Silk Blouse with Tie Neck
products.description: Luxurious 100% silk blouse featuring a delicate tie-neck detail. Relaxed fit with concealed button placket. Pair with tailored trousers or denim for refined polish.

products.name: Tailored Wool Blazer
products.description: A sharply tailored single-breasted blazer in Italian wool. Notched lapels, two-button closure, and interior pockets. The cornerstone of a sophisticated capsule wardrobe.

products.name: Midi A-Line Skirt
products.description: A graceful A-line midi skirt in structured cotton twill. Features a concealed zip back and knee-length slit for ease of movement. Pairs beautifully with tucked-in blouses.

products.name: Cotton Cable Knit Sweater
products.description: A classic cable-knit sweater in soft Pima cotton. Ribbed cuffs and hem with a relaxed crew neckline. The perfect layering piece for cooler days.

products.name: Pleated Midi Dress
products.description: An ethereal pleated midi dress with delicate spaghetti straps and a flowing silhouette. Made from lightweight crepe with a hidden back zipper. Ideal for garden parties and summer evenings.

products.name: High-Rise Skinny Jeans
products.description: Premium stretch denim with a high-rise waist and skinny leg. Features authentic five-pocket styling with a hint of stretch for all-day comfort. A modern classic.

products.name: Trench Coat with Belt
products.description: A timeless double-breasted trench coat in water-resistant cotton gabardine. Epaulettes, storm flap, and a self-tie belt define this iconic silhouette. Inseam pockets and gun flap details.
